stem.text: An object is stretched until it reaches the elastic limit.
Which statement must describe the stress on the object when it is at the elastic limit?

A.text: It is the maximum stress for which the object obeys Hooke’s law.

B.text: It is the maximum stress that can be applied to the object before it has elastic deformation.

C.text: It is the maximum stress that can be applied to the object before it has plastic deformation.

D.text: It is the maximum stress the object can withstand before it breaks.
